thread:
ashley: Auditor Liz asked for a compact evidence set for the automated SA deprovision job we ran on Mar 20. They want RBAC change proof, KMS key-tagging events showing keys marked retired, vuln triage notes (one related CVE), and a brief incident/exercise timeline. Can someone assemble?

vik: I can grab the RBAC diffs + sample `kubectl auth can-i` outputs. Scope prod only.

tom: I'll pull KMS tagging events and key metadata. Use window 2026-03-20T01:00Z..2026-03-20T04:00Z. Auditor wants evidence that keys were tagged "retired" before schedule-for-destroy.

sec-bot: required artifacts: PR + approver, rbacs pre/post YAML, k8s audit slice, KMS key metadata + tag events, vuln triage doc, incident-exercise timeline, README-chainofcustody.md, sha256s. Redact PII. Retention policy: 7 years.

vik: pulled RBAC pre/post. PR permalink included: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/6077 (approver: corinne). Replaced service emails with <REDACTED-SVC>.

ashley: include the deprovision job run id and CI id. Also note this was a scheduled maintenance exercise coordinated with SOC.

vik: deprovision job id: job-20260320-deprov-88, CI run: ci-20260320-9912. Added to metadata file.

sec-bot: KMS export hint: use `gcloud kms keys describe` and `gcloud logging read` filters. Provide SHA256 for artifacts.

 tom: exported KMS metadata: kms-keys.json and tag-events.log. Confirmed tags applied: `status:retired` then `scheduled_destroy:2026-04-20T00:00:00Z`. No export/import API calls found in window. Command used: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.UpdateCryptoKey\" AND protoPayload.request.@type: \"type.googleapis.com\"" --start-time=2026-03-20T01:00:00Z --end-time=2026-03-20T04:00:00Z`

vik: k8s audit slice shows rolebinding removals for two SAs and a short-lived service-account rename. I added `kubectl auth can-i` outputs executed as the removed principals showing denied access post-change.

corinne: vuln triage: SEC-4720 relates to a dependency in the deprovision pipeline. CVE-2026-2101 fixed in 4.1.2; mitigation applied to prod before the job. Attached triage summary and ticket link (internal): SEC-4720.

ashley: the auditor also asked for the exercise timeline that shows approvals and smoke test success. We ran a simulated incident exercise earlier same day; include timeline.txt.

sec-bot: ensure chain-of-custody README includes who exported, method, UTC timestamp, redaction notes, and SHA256 list. Also note where raw exports are stored internally.

 tom: assembled bundle: rbacs_pre.yaml, rbacs_post.yaml, rbac-diff.patch, kubernetes-audit-slice.json, can-i-checks.txt, kms-keys.json, tag-events.log, SEC-4720-triage.md, incident-exercise-timeline.txt, README-chainofcustody.md. Computing sha256s now.

tom: computed hashes and added them to README. Internal raw bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-internal-audit/exercises/mar-2026/1781234567/raw/, auditor bundle (redacted + hashed) to s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/exercises/mar-2026/1781234567/auditor.zip

auditor-liz: received link, thank you. Quick Q: can you confirm whether any principal used a long-lived key material export during the exercise? We need explicit confirmation of no material export.

tom: confirmed: KMS audit slice contains only UpdateCryptoKey and CreateCryptoKeyVersion events; no ImportCryptoKeyVersion or external export API events. Added grep snippet to README: `grep -E "ImportCryptoKeyVersion|CryptoKeyMaterialExport" tag-events.log` -> no matches.

vik: added sanitized CI artifacts permalink for traceability and the job logs showing smoke tests passed (smoke-tests/deprov-88-verify.log).

corinne: added short narrative for control mapping: "Scheduled deprovision exercise on 2026-03-20 removed two service principals and retired two KMS keys. Changes went through PR #6077 (approver: corinne). Post-change verification included kubectl auth checks, CI smoke tests (ci-20260320-9912), and KMS tag verification. No key material exports detected. Artifacts (redacted) and SHA256s provided."

auditor-liz: that's sufficient for SOC2 evidence sampling. We may ask for another sample later but this is acceptable. Thanks for the clear README.

sec-bot: ticket SEC-4720 status -> evidence-provided

ashley: closing loop and noting this sample in Confluence control-mapping under CC3/CC7. Thanks team :pray:
